messages.gate: Hello, this is the AWS DevOps Agent on-call line. A priority $.Attributes.priority incident is in progress on service $.Attributes.service. Press 1 to talk to the on-call assistant.
messages.gate_pin: Hello, this is the AWS DevOps Agent on-call line. A priority $.Attributes.priority incident is in progress. Press 1 to talk to the on-call assistant.
messages.pin_prompt: Please enter your on-call PIN, then press pound.
messages.pin_retry: That PIN was not recognized. Please enter your on-call PIN again, then press pound.
messages.pin_failed: The PIN could not be verified. The incident details are being sent to the on-call channel. Goodbye.
messages.greeting: This is the on-call assistant. Do you want me to summarize the incident?
messages.ack_ok: Got it, the incident is acknowledged in the ticket under your name. Good luck, goodbye.
messages.ack_noop: This incident is no longer open, nothing was changed. Goodbye.
messages.bye: All right, the incident stays open. Goodbye.
messages.ack_failed: The acknowledgment could not be recorded. Please update the ticket manually.
messages.fallback: Hello, this is the AWS DevOps Agent on-call line. Priority $.Attributes.priority incident on service $.Attributes.service. The voice assistant is unavailable, please check the ticket.
messages.no_input: Key 1 was not pressed. The incident stays open, the details are in the ticket. Goodbye.
messages.no_input_notified: Key 1 was not pressed. The incident details are sent to you in writing. Goodbye.
messages.recording_notice: This call may be recorded for quality and record-keeping.
messages.ack_confirm: To confirm you take incident $.Attributes.ticketSpoken, press 1.
messages.ack_unconfirmed: The acknowledgment was not confirmed. The incident stays open, please check the ticket. Goodbye.

status.TIMED_OUT: timed out, no root cause found

labels.ack: acknowledged by voice through the Connect AI agent
labels.no_answer: not acknowledged by voice: 1 was not pressed on the on-call call
labels.not_connected: not acknowledged by voice: the on-call call was not answered
labels.notify_sms: On-call: {priority} priority incident {ticketId} on {service}, investigation {statusText}. Not acknowledged by phone, please check the ticket.
labels.not_acknowledged: not acknowledged by voice: the on-call call was answered but not acknowledged
labels.notify_failed: notification could not be sent: SMS and email both failed
labels.notify_no_budget: notification not attempted: no time left in this attempt, it will be retried
labels.ack_receipt_sms: On-call: you acknowledged incident {ticketId} on {service} at {ackAt}. If this was not you, check the ticket now.
